candidates.reason: A real banner re-layout: logo on the left, headline and CTA stacked on the right, everything readable. Flaws: the logo is small and floats in a large empty left zone without sharing any baseline or top edge with the text block. The headline crowds the top edge while the CTA sits low near the bottom. A bokeh dot sits just past 'Light' and another just above the CTA, adding clutter right next to the copy.

The CTA 'Shop the / Summer Line' is squeezed into a two-line wrap and jammed against the right edge, with a bokeh dot sitting on 'Summer Line', which is an unwanted collision. The CTA is cut off from the headline and reads as a stray fragment. The logo and wordmark are shrunk to near-illegible size at top center, and the three elements line up on no shared axis.

Identical to candidate 2: the CTA wraps awkwardly into two lines hard against the right edge, a bokeh dot overlaps 'Summer Line', the tiny logo is barely readable, and the CTA is not grouped with the headline.

The original was shrunk to fit the banner height instead of being rearranged. The logo, wordmark and CTA are microscopic and unreadable, the headline is tiny, and more than half the canvas is empty, so it does not suit the banner format at all.
